sentence_stem: If I had studied harder last year,
correct_completion: I would be a doctor by now.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder last year, I would be a doctor by now.
acceptable_variants: I would probably be a doctor by now.
I would be a qualified doctor today.

options.text: I will be a doctor by now.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' expresses a real future prediction, but the if-clause describes an unreal past condition, so the result needs 'would'.

options.text: I was a doctor by now.
options.why_wrong: A simple past describes a fact, not the hypothetical result of the unreal condition; the result needs 'would' plus a base verb.

options.text: I would be a doctor by now.
I would become a doctor tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: 'Tomorrow' conflicts with 'by now', which refers to the present, so the time reference does not fit the sentence.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals (type 3 if-clause with a type 2 present result)
explanation: This is a mixed conditional. The if-clause refers to an unreal past (had studied), while the result refers to the present (by now), so the result uses would plus a base verb. Turkish speakers often align the time of the result with the time of the condition, which leads them to choose a past form here; the result must instead point to the present time.
translation: Geçen yıl daha çok çalışsaydım, şu an doktor olurdum.
